in_marathi.name: Amlesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amlesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amlesh derives from the Sanskrit words ‘amr’ meaning immortal or imperishable, and ‘leh’ meaning body or form. This name is associated with the gods Vishnu and Rama, symbolizing their eternal nature.
